create_LongFactDataset: create a LongFactDataset dataclass with a topic string and optional path
list_topics: list all available LongFact dataset topics from the DATASETS collection
load_datasets: load and merge a list of LongFactDataset objects into a single list of prompt strings
load_datasets_from_folder: load all JSONL LongFact datasets from a directory into a list of prompt strings
load_longfact_concepts: load all LongFact concept prompts from the concepts folder into a list of strings
